title: Caller is not the account holder and can't verify
tricky: The husband is honest that it's his wife's account and can't give her email or phone. The right outcome is no action at all, however reasonable the request sounds.

source.what_we_took: Customer can't provide the email needed for verification and the agent can't confirm identity.

resolution_summary: Do not verify, refund, credit or escalate. Explain the account holder (Ellen Park) needs to contact support.

user.persona: James Park, easygoing, uses his wife's Forkful account for family dinners.
user.situation: Tonight's Taqueria Luz order on your wife Ellen's account was missing the horchata. You're contacting support yourself.
user.goal: Get the horchata refunded. If told only the account holder can do it, push back once, then accept that Ellen will contact support.
facts: Your name is James Park. The account is in your wife's name, Ellen Park.
You don't know which email is on the account.
You don't know Ellen's phone number by heart. Your own phone is +1 415-555-0199.
reveal_rules: If asked for the name on the account, say it's your wife's account, Ellen Park, and that you're James.
If asked for a phone number, give your own.
behaviors: Be honest that you're not Ellen. Never pretend to be her.
Push back once ('she's busy, can't you just sort it out?'), then accept.
user.opening: hey, the horchata was missing from our order tonight
user.end_condition: the agent has refunded it or explained that Ellen needs to contact support, and you've acknowledged it.
